speaker: melody
text: Bye, friends! Say hello to the flowers for me!

speaker: lumi
text: Thank you, Melody! To the flower garden!

speaker: lumi
text: Wow! A whole garden, floating above a lake!

speaker: bobo
text: This garden is beautiful! Do they grow banana trees here?

speaker: kiko
text: Careful, Bobo! That flower might bite!

speaker: draco
text: Relax! I know everything about flowers!

speaker: draco
text: Ah... ahh... ah-CHOO!

speaker: lumi
text: Oh no... the flowers are closing, and losing their colours!

speaker: petal
text: Hello! I'm Petal, guardian of the Floating Flower Garden!

speaker: petal
text: Our Bloom Crystal stopped shining. The whole garden is fading!

speaker: petal
text: Watch my flower magic! Ah... ahh...

speaker: petal
text: ah-CHOO!

speaker: kiko
text: Bobo, I think you've become a walking flower!

speaker: bobo
text: At least I smell delicious!

speaker: petal
text: Follow me! Every island has its own magic flower!

speaker: bobo
text: Ooh! A giant banana!

speaker: draco
text: Behold! I am the Flower Dragon!

speaker: draco
text: Ah... ah-CHOO!

speaker: petal
text: Ahh... ah-CHOO!

speaker: petal
text: The Bloom Crystal is under the lake, behind the flower gate!

speaker: lumi
text: The flowers glow in order: pink, yellow, blue, purple!

speaker: bobo
text: I came to save a garden, not become gardening equipment!

speaker: petal
text: The crystal is so dark... What if my magic is gone?

speaker: lumi
text: Your magic is still inside you, Petal. We believe in you!

speaker: bobo
text: I think the flowers are trying to eat me!

speaker: kiko
text: Surprise!

speaker: draco
text: Time for my heroic landing!

speaker: bobo
text: Ooh! A golden banana flower!

speaker: lumi
text: An island in the stars? I wonder what magic is waiting there!

speaker: narrator
text: Next time... the secret of the Starlight Island!
